name: influencer-gift-form
description: Make one-time gift links for creators from a chat, then see who ordered and what got delivered, for Shopify brands.

interface.longDescription:
Influencer Gift Form is the gifting step of your creator outreach. Brands on Shopify use it to send products to influencers as gifts: each creator gets a link, picks their gift, types their address, and the order lands in the brand's Shopify store as a gift order. No DMs asking for sizes and addresses, no copy-pasting orders.

Connect it to ChatGPT and you can run that from the chat. Paste the creators who said yes to a campaign, and ChatGPT makes a one-time gift link for each of them, already filled in with their name and email. Later, ask who from that campaign ordered, what they picked, and what has shipped or been delivered.

What it can do:
- Make one-time gift links for one creator or a list of up to 50, grouped by campaign
- List a campaign's links: unused, used or canceled
- Cancel an unused link (it asks you first)
- Find gift orders by campaign, creator, form, date or status, with shipping and delivery status
- Find creators you have gifted before, with their gift history
- List your gift forms and sum up your gifting program

Influencer Gift Form never sends emails or messages to creators. ChatGPT hands you the links and you send them however you already reach creators. It only reaches the one store you connect.

You need Influencer Gift Form installed on your Shopify store. Sign in with your store email; we email you a link.
defaultPrompt: Make gift links for these creators for our Spring Drop campaign:
Who from Spring Drop ordered, and what's been delivered?
Which Spring Drop creators haven't used their gift link yet?

positive.description: Gift links for a list of creators under a campaign
positive.prompt: Make gift links for these creators for our Spring Drop campaign: Alex Kim, alex.kim@example.com, Instagram @alexkim.sample; Rosa Diaz, rosa.diaz@example.com, TikTok @rosadiaz.sample
positive.expected_behavior: Returns two one-time links on igf-reviewer.myshopify.com/apps/influencer_gift/..., one per creator, each with campaign 'Spring Drop', status 'unused' and the creator's name and email prefilled. No email is sent to the creators.

positive.prompt: Which Spring Drop creators haven't used their gift link yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the unused Spring Drop links, including Maya Lopez, Jordan Reed and Priya Shah (plus any links made earlier in the session), each with its URL.

positive.description: Cancel a link for a creator who backed out
positive.prompt: Make a Spring Drop gift link for Chris Park (chris.park@example.com), then cancel it, he backed out.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the link, then (after the user confirms, since cancel is marked destructive) cancels it. The link's status comes back as 'canceled'. No order is touched.

positive.prompt: How is our influencer gifting going? Give me a summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows gift orders by stage (at least 1 order), gift links created, used, unused and canceled, and how many gift orders the store has left this month.

positive.description: Latest order and what the creator picked
positive.prompt: Show me our most recent gift order and what the creator picked.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the test order placed through the 'Creator gifting' form on the reviewer store and lists the products chosen, its status and the shipping address on file.

negative.description: Writing social content is out of scope
negative.prompt: Write an Instagram caption for my new skincare launch.

negative.description: Finding new influencers is out of scope (IGF only knows creators you already gifted)
negative.prompt: Find me 20 fitness influencers on TikTok with over 100K followers.

negative.description: Paying influencers is out of scope
negative.prompt: Send @mayalopez.sample a payment for her sponsored post.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: one-time gift links for creators (single or up to 50), campaigns, list and cancel links, gift order search with shipping and delivery status, creator history, gift forms and a program summary.
